data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For most small online stores, I'd recommend **Stripe** as the best all-round payment processor. However, if you're using Shopify, **Shopify Payments** is usually the better choice.

If you're operating in Australia, there are a few particularly good options worth comparing.

## My top 5 payment processors

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Excellent for online-only stores.
- Easy integration with WooCommerce and other platforms.
- Supports subscriptions, cards and digital wallets.
- Australian domestic card pricing around 1.65% + A\$0.30.

[Stripe Australia](https://stripe.com/au)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Integrated directly into Shopify.
- Simple payment management.
- Supports major cards and digital wallets.
- Avoids additional third-party transaction fees charged by Shopify.

[Shopify Payments Australia](https://www.shopify.com/au/payments)

---

![Airwallex Logo Vector PNG | Modern Global Payments Brand Icon  - freepng](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/cFbGTguMuX4NolZbruyR2e9UuMWzIcApce9GwnB52sKTkNYR004hxhoF8Ij9azaRbMXEJgKRHsclL3c7QjB8TJjaOTDcrg4k3A5inD7vzblx0d1z3hgdBOQOwY04EZUWK2_K2j2_0mXQsLUCmgN2eSvYqOiDe6vtcOsjp3z8pqXOq4rreZAlQfF7YiTD92T7?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Airwallex**

- Excellent for international sales.
- Competitive Australian domestic card pricing.
- Multi-currency accounts and settlements.
- Useful for businesses buying and selling overseas.

[Airwallex Australia](https://www.airwallex.com/au)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PayPal**

- Recognised and trusted by many shoppers.
- Easy to add to an existing website.
- Useful as an additional checkout option.
- Can have higher processing fees.

[PayPal Australia](https://www.paypal.com/au/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Square**

- Good for businesses selling online and in person.
- Combines online payments and physical POS.
- Straightforward business management tools.

[Square Australia](https://squareup.com/au/en)

Pricing is indicative; actual fees depend on card type, country, plan and payment method. Sources: [www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/au/blog/payment-processing-for-small-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd choose

| Your situation | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| Starting a small online store | Stripe |
| Using Shopify | Shopify Payments |
| Using WooCommerce | Stripe |
| Selling internationally | Airwallex |
| Want customers to pay with PayPal | Add PayPal alongside your main processor |
| Selling online and in person | Square |


**My preferred setup for a new Australian online store\:** Stripe as the primary processor, with PayPal as an additional checkout option.
